breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: WalkieTalkey needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: WalkieTalkey Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Shortcut Behavior
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

retiredNotice.title: Old models no longer work with WalkieTalkey
retiredNotice.description: They're taking up {{size}} on your computer.
retiredNotice.deleteFailed: Some old models couldn't be deleted. Check the log for details.

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside WalkieTalkey

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: Hardware Acceleration
transcribe.description: Choose the hardware used for transcription. Auto uses the GPU when available and falls back to the CPU.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start WalkieTalkey when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the WalkieTalkey icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

longFormChunking.title: Long Audio Chunking
longFormChunking.description: Splits long recordings at pauses before transcribing, which typically improves transcription performance.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Select an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible provider.

apiFormat.title: API Format
apiFormat.description: Request format expected by your custom endpoint.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of WalkieTalkey

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach WalkieTalkey. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching WalkieTalkey normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after WalkieTalkey updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where WalkieTalkey stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: WalkieTalkey's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: WalkieTalkey needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the WalkieTalkey interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether WalkieTalkey follows your system theme or stays light or dark

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

welcome.title: Danish speech to text. Free, and it runs on your own computer.

model.title: Get the speech model
model.lead: WalkieTalkey downloads Edda, a Danish speech model of about 890 MB. Speech becomes text on your own computer.
model.continueNote: You can go on while it downloads.
model.importNote: If you already have the model file, choose it with Import model file.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.lead: WalkieTalkey needs the microphone to hear you
microphone.why: WalkieTalkey records while you hold the key. Speech becomes text on your own computer.
microphone.promptNote: macOS will now ask whether WalkieTalkey may use the microphone. Choose Allow.
microphone.deniedMac: WalkieTalkey has no access to the microphone. Turn it on in System Settings under Privacy & Security, Microphone.
microphone.deniedWindows: Windows does not let apps use the microphone. Turn it on under Settings, Privacy & security, Microphone.

key.title: The key
key.copilotNote: Many new laptops have a Copilot key instead of Right Ctrl. To use it or another key, choose Choose another key and press the key.
key.monitoringWhy: macOS must give WalkieTalkey Input Monitoring before the app can see that you hold fn. Turn WalkieTalkey on in the list that opens.
key.globeWhy: macOS also uses the fn key (the globe key) for its own functions. Open Keyboard and set Press globe key to Do Nothing.
key.restartWhy: macOS usually applies the access only after the app has started again. WalkieTalkey restarts and continues here.

paste.title: Paste automatically
paste.lead: So the text can go where you type
paste.why: macOS asks whether WalkieTalkey may use Accessibility. It is needed to paste the text. Without it, the text goes to the clipboard and you paste it yourself with {{key}}.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: When you dictate from the phone, the text goes to the clipboard and a notification says it is ready.
notifications.example: Remember to buy milk on the way home
notifications.denied: Notifications are not on. You can turn them on in the system settings.

phone.title: Phone
phone.lead: Do you also want to talk into your phone?
phone.why: Hold the button in the phone app, talk, and let go. The text appears on this computer. Encrypted from phone to computer.

try.title: Try it
try.lead: Hold {{key}} and say: Hi, this is my first dictation.
try.fieldLabel: Type here, or hold the key and talk

model.downloadFailed: Could not download the speech model. Try again.
model.importFailed: The file is not a model WalkieTalkey knows. Choose the file you downloaded.

keys.pressNow: Press the key you want to use
keys.recordFailed: Could not read the key. Try again.

pairing.title: Pair a phone
pairing.howTo: Open WalkieTalkey on the phone, tap Pair with a computer, and scan the code.
pairing.failed: Could not make a code. Check the connection and try again.
pairing.noScreenShare: Do not pair while you share your screen. The code works for 10 minutes, and anyone who sees it can use it.
pairing.getApp: No app yet? Open {{url}} on the phone.

notify.phoneJoined: New phone paired: {{name}}. Was that you?

pill.notReady: The speech model is not ready yet
pill.error: Could not download the speech model. Try again.

paused.text: WalkieTalkey is paused. The key does nothing, and the phone is told that the computer is paused.

general.autostartDesc: WalkieTalkey starts when you log in to the computer.
general.soundsDesc: A short sound when recording starts and stops.
general.pillPlaceDesc: The pill shows that WalkieTalkey is listening and what happened to the text.
general.pillForPhone: Show the pill for phone dictations
general.pillForPhoneDesc: The icon always shows when the phone is sending audio.
general.showText: Show the text in the notification
general.showTextDesc: Turn off while sharing your screen or in meetings. The notification then only says how to paste.
general.preview: This is how the notification looks:
general.languageDesc: The language of WalkieTalkey's windows. The speech model is Danish.

key.keyDescMac: Hold the key while you talk. Keyboards not made by Apple often do not send fn, so choose another key here.
key.keyDescWindows: Hold the key while you talk. If your computer has a Copilot key, you can choose it here.
key.holdDesc: Records while you hold the key.
key.tapDesc: Tap once to start and once more to stop.
key.testDesc: Hold the key. The key below goes down when WalkieTalkey sees it.

text.output: When you dictate with the key
text.outputDesc: With Clipboard only, the text goes to the clipboard and you paste it yourself with {{key}}.
text.noAccessibility: WalkieTalkey has no Accessibility access, so the text goes to the clipboard.
text.punctuationDesc: Automatic adds full stops and commas when the speech model has not set them.
text.shareDescMac: When off, the text only goes to this Mac's clipboard, so Universal Clipboard does not send it to your other Apple devices.
text.shareDescWindows: When off, the text stays out of Windows clipboard history and the cloud clipboard.

vocabulary.wordsDesc: Names and terms that must be spelled right. The newest are on top and used first.
vocabulary.companyList: Your organisation's word list is used as well.
vocabulary.replacementsDesc: When I say X, write Y. Whole words, ignoring case.
vocabulary.developerWordsDesc: Words like pull request, deploy, standup, merge, commit, frontend and backend, for Danish with English terms.
vocabulary.importExportDesc: Plain text files with one entry per line. Replacements are written as X => Y.
vocabulary.copied: The file could not be saved, so the list was copied to the clipboard.
vocabulary.exportFailed: The list could not be saved.

cleanup.intro: Optional. An AI corrects the text after speech has become text on your computer. Only the text is sent, not the audio.
cleanup.whenNeeded: When there is something to fix
cleanup.whenNeededDesc: Recommended once a provider is set up. Only dictations where you correct yourself or repeat something are sent.
cleanup.shift: Only when I also hold Shift
cleanup.shiftDesc: Hold Shift when you release the key.
cleanup.onlyLocal: Your organisation only allows cleanup that runs on the computer.
cleanup.appleUnavailable: Apple Intelligence needs a Mac with Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or newer.
cleanup.modelDesc: The name of the model at the provider.
cleanup.endpointDesc: The address of an OpenAI-compatible service, for example Azure OpenAI, LM Studio or Ollama.
cleanup.keyDesc: Your own key. It is kept in the computer's keychain and only sent to the provider.
cleanup.keyManaged: Your organisation has set a key.
cleanup.keyStoredPlaceholder: Type a new key to change it
cleanup.keyFailed: The key could not be saved.
cleanup.consent: The text (not the audio) is sent to {{provider}} every time you dictate.
cleanup.sentWhenNeeded: The text (not the audio) is sent to {{provider}} when there is something to fix.
cleanup.staysApple: The text stays on your computer. Apple Intelligence runs on your Mac.
cleanup.staysLocal: The text is sent to a service on your own computer.
cleanup.smallModels: Small local models (under about 3 billion parameters) often ignore the instructions. Use Apple Intelligence on a Mac or a larger model.
cleanup.showSentDesc: The history shows the exact text, the provider and how long it took for every dictation that was sent.

phone.intro: Hold the button in the phone app, talk, and let go. The text goes to the clipboard on this computer. Encrypted from phone to computer.
phone.removeFailed: The phone could not be removed. Try again.
phone.removeFailedNamed: {{name}} could not be removed. Try again.
phone.pairDesc: Shows a code that you scan in the phone app.
phone.disconnected: No connection to the relay. Trying again.
phone.joinedHelp: If it was not you, choose Remove. The phone can then no longer send to this computer.

modelSettings.keepLoadedDesc: With Always, the first dictation after a break is as fast as the rest. Choose a shorter time if the computer is short on memory.
modelSettings.redownloadDesc: Deletes the selected model and downloads it again, in case the file is broken.
modelSettings.spaceDesc: The speech models on this computer.
modelSettings.othersDesc: Edda is made for Danish. Ekko v1 Tiny is faster on slow computers. The others are Handy's models.

updates.autoDesc: Checks for updates at start and every 6 hours and installs them when the app starts again.
updates.channelDesc: Beta gets new versions before everyone else.
updates.failed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.

advanced.relayDesc: The relay passes the encrypted audio from the phone on to the computer. Only change it if you run your own relay. Phones must be paired again afterwards.
advanced.phoneAppDesc: The address the pairing code points to.
advanced.importDesc: Choose a model file you have already downloaded. WalkieTalkey checks that it is a model it knows.
advanced.dataFolderDesc: Models, history and settings are kept here.
advanced.debugModeDesc: Shows extra settings and logs more details.
advanced.logsDesc: The log files are on your computer. Only share them if you want to.
advanced.pasteDelaysDesc: If the text sometimes is not pasted, a longer pause before and after can help.

cli.title: Command line
cli.desc: WalkieTalkey can be controlled from a terminal, for example from a shortcut in another program.
cli.noTray: Starts without an icon in the menu bar.
cli.file: Turns an audio file into text and prints the result.
cli.listModels: Lists the models the app knows.

about.claims: Speech becomes text on your own computer. No account. No tracking.

credit.walkietalkey: Apache-2.0. Free for everyone, companies included.
credit.handy: WalkieTalkey builds on Handy by CJ Pais. MIT.
credit.transcribe: Runs the speech models on the computer, together with ggml. MIT.
credit.edda: Danish speech model from the Alexandra Institute, built on OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo. Apache-2.0.
credit.ekkoTiny: Fast Danish speech model from RyeAI, built on NVIDIA Parakeet. NVIDIA Open Model License and CC BY 4.0.
credit.onnx: Runs the punctuation model. Microsoft, MIT.
credit.silero: Finds speech in the audio. Silero Team, MIT.
credit.albert: The typeface, by Andreas Rasmussen. SIL Open Font License 1.1.

about.codeDesc: All the code is open on GitHub.
about.privacyDesc: What data exists and where it is kept.
about.trademarkDesc: The name and logo are not covered by the code licence.

history.loadFailed: The history could not be loaded.
history.retentionDesc: Older dictations are deleted at start and every hour.
history.keepAudioDesc: Keeps the audio for at most 7 days. The audio stays on your computer.
history.deleteAllDesc: Deletes every dictation on this computer.
history.deleteAllConfirm: Every dictation and all kept audio are deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
history.storage: The history is kept in the app's folder. It is only encrypted if the computer's disk is encrypted with FileVault or BitLocker.
